ceo_directive: No EXACT_PASSAGE without full provenance; one passage can't auto-satisfy multiple limitations

required_fields_for_every_EXACT_PASSAGE.exact_passage: string — verbatim text from the claim (not specification, not abstract)
required_fields_for_every_EXACT_PASSAGE.limitation_id: string — which L1-L6 this passage supports
required_fields_for_every_EXACT_PASSAGE.evidence_source: string — how the passage was retrieved (e.g., 'PatSnap P018 claim-data')
required_fields_for_every_EXACT_PASSAGE.retrieval_timestamp: ISO 8601 — when the claim was retrieved
required_fields_for_every_EXACT_PASSAGE.content_hash: SHA-256 of the exact_passage — for tamper detection

ci_rules.rule: Every EXACT_PASSAGE must have all 9 required fields populated
One passage cannot automatically satisfy multiple limitations
ci_rules.ci_check: If the same content_hash appears for >1 limitation_id, each mapping must have an independent explanation in mapping_rationale
ci_rules.failure_action: CI_FAIL — reused passage without independent rationale

ci_rules.rule: Passage must be from CLAIM text, not specification/abstract
ci_rules.ci_check: claim_type field must be INDEPENDENT or DEPENDENT; passage_location must be within the claim, not 'specification' or 'abstract'
ci_rules.failure_action: CI_FAIL — non-claim passage treated as claim evidence

ci_rules.rule: content_hash must match SHA-256 of exact_passage
ci_rules.ci_check: recompute SHA-256 of exact_passage, compare to content_hash field
ci_rules.failure_action: CI_FAIL — hash mismatch (passage tampered or mis-copied)

v31_defect_this_prevents: V3.1 had 35 EXPRESS disclosures with empty claim_number and passages reused across limitations (preamble keyword matching). This schema makes that structurally impossible.

template.exact_passage: An endovascularly implantable shunt device for draining cerebrospinal fluid...
